gaps.sentence: She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
The negotiators refused to give ___ to the hijackers' demands.
gaps.explanation: give in (to) = stop arguing and accept; give up = quit.

gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: The new law will phase ___ disposable plastics by 2030.
gaps.explanation: phase out = gradually stop using something.

gaps.sentence: We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
The strike brought ___ major changes in the law.
Can I ___ on these boots before buying them?
gaps.explanation: try on = put on clothes/shoes to check the fit.
